_readme: Filings whose information table is another filer's book (a filing agent's slip), checked against EDGAR by hand. The row keeps its EDGAR numbers but is marked `misfiled` in universe.json (api/_lib/misfiledBooks.js): left out of every size ranking and listing, of the stock totals and of the headline total, and its page says whose table it is. `acc` limits the entry to that one filing: a later, correct filing clears it. `correctedBy` is the 13F-HR/A with which the filer restated its own book for that period, checked by hand like the entry itself: the period is then read with that amendment applied (a restatement replaces the table) and is the filer's own again (no mark, no note, back in the totals), while the original document on its own stays marked. `declared` is the filer's own cover-page total (Form 13F Information Table Value Total), in dollars.

filers.reason: The 2026-06-30 information table is Charles Schwab Investment Management's (3,439 identical lines, $751.32B); Sixth Street's own cover page declares $579.2M. The filer corrected it the same day, 2026-08-14: 13F-HR/A 0001752724-26-000055 (amendment no. 1, RESTATEMENT) restates 2026-06-30 as Sixth Street's own book, 9 table entries (7 securities) and $579,182,557, equal to its cover. They are the seven names of its 2026-03-31 filing 0001752724-26-000034 (7 securities, $710,721,530): four at the same share count (PG&E 13,609,288, MasterBrand 4,905,383, Sixth Street Specialty Lending 2,714,226, Sprinklr 5,670,000), three lower (Caris Life Sciences 14,385,399 -> 7,327,041, Atlanta Braves Holdings 1,553,822 -> 1,551,322, Essent Group 400,000 -> 200,000). Entered 2026-11-10: until then the quarter was read with the amendment applied (its figures were right) yet stayed marked and the page fell back to 2026-03-31. The quarter is Sixth Street's own (`correctedBy`); the original 0001752724-26-000051 on its own is still Schwab's table.

The 2026-06-30 filing is Kingsbury Capital Investment Advisors' book (121 of 121 lines identical to Kingsbury's own 2026-06-30 filing 0001104659-26-100644, cover total $118,195,925 identical too, so KMT's own Q2 total is unknown). Corrected 2026-10-22: the earlier entry had the direction backwards. Kingsbury's Q1 (113 lines, $106.4M) -> Q2 -> Q3 (0001104659-26-117244, 107 lines, $106.0M) is one continuous book (Illinois Tool Works 53,440 -> 53,011 -> 50,943 sh; Intensity Therapeutics 38,054 -> 496,493 -> 706,523; Offerpad 0 -> 303,595 -> 724,649), while KMT's own 2025-09-30, 2025-12-31 and 2026-03-31 tables hold 16-17 lines and ~$185M with none of those names. Same filing agent (0001104659) for both; Kingsbury (Wilmette IL, CRD 145658) and KMT (Hermosa Beach CA, CRD 328911) are unrelated advisers. The filer corrected it on 2026-11-10: 13F-HR/A 0001104659-26-125011 (amendment no. 1, RESTATEMENT) restates 2026-06-30 as KMT's own book, 18 lines and $210,630,047, equal to its cover (18 entries, $210,630,047). 17 of the 18 lines are KMT's 2026-03-31 lines (14 at the same share count; Vanguard Index Funds 922908769 291,438 -> 294,528 sh, iShares Trust 464287200 100,107 -> 97,360, Vanguard Municipal Bond Funds 922907746 20,300 -> 21,020), one is new (Eli Lilly, 169 sh), and 16 carry into the 2026-09-30 filing 0001104659-26-125007 (16 lines, $216,079,457) filed the same day; only 8 names (Apple, NVIDIA and the like) also appear among Kingsbury's 121. The quarter is read with the amendment applied (`correctedBy`); the original 0001104659-26-091013 on its own is still Kingsbury's table.
